tests.title: Daily routines
tests.vocab: family, breakfast, table, kitchen, eating, talking, food, morning, together, happy

questions.q: What time do you usually get up?

hints.better: I usually get up at 6 a.m. because I have an early class.
hints.strong: I usually get up around 6 a.m. on weekdays so I can have breakfast and get ready for school. At the weekend I often sleep until 8.

questions.q: What do you usually have for breakfast?

hints.better: I usually have bread, eggs and a glass of milk.
hints.strong: I usually have a simple breakfast — bread with eggs and milk. Sometimes I eat noodles if I have more time.

questions.q: Do you go to school in the morning or in the afternoon?

hints.basic: I go to school in the morning.
hints.better: I go to school in the morning, from 7 to 11.
hints.strong: I usually go to school in the morning, from about 7 to 11. On some days I also have afternoon classes.

questions.q: What do you do after school?

hints.better: After school I do my homework and then I play football.
hints.strong: After school I usually do my homework first. Then I play football with my friends or watch a short video to relax.

questions.q: What time do you usually go to bed?

hints.basic: I go to bed at 10 o'clock.
hints.better: I usually go to bed at about 10 p.m.
hints.strong: I usually go to bed at about 10 p.m. on weekdays, but at the weekend I sometimes stay up later.

picture.vocabTip: Start with “In this picture, I can see…”, then say who the people are, what they are doing, and one or two more details.

hints.basic: In this picture, I can see four people. They are a family. They are having breakfast. I can also see a table and some food.
hints.better: In this picture, I can see four people. They are a family in the kitchen. They are having breakfast and talking together. I can also see a table, cups and some food. They look happy.
hints.strong: In this picture, I can see a family of four sitting around a table in the kitchen. They are having breakfast together and chatting. There is food and drinks on the table, and the atmosphere looks warm and happy. It seems like a normal morning at home.

tests.title: At school
tests.vocab: students, teacher, classroom, desk, book, writing, listening, board, subject, break

questions.q: What is your favourite subject?

hints.better: My favourite subject is English because it is useful.
hints.strong: My favourite subject is English because I enjoy speaking and learning new words. It also helps me for my future job.

questions.q: Who is your favourite teacher?

hints.basic: My favourite teacher is Ms. Hoa.
hints.better: My favourite teacher is Ms. Hoa. She is kind and funny.
hints.strong: My favourite teacher is Ms. Hoa. She explains things clearly and always encourages us, so I feel more confident in class.

questions.q: How do you go to school?

hints.basic: I go to school by bike.
hints.better: I usually go to school by bike with my friend.
hints.strong: I usually go to school by bike because my house is not far. When it rains, my parents take me by motorbike.

questions.q: Do you like studying English? Why?

hints.better: Yes, I like studying English because it is interesting.
hints.strong: Yes, I like studying English because I can watch films and talk to people from other countries. It is hard sometimes, but it is fun.

questions.q: What do you usually do during break time?

hints.better: During break time I talk with my friends and eat a snack.
hints.strong: During break time I usually chat with my classmates, buy a snack, and sometimes play a short game in the yard.

picture.vocabTip: Say how many students you see, where they are, what they are doing, and mention the teacher or the board.

hints.basic: In this picture, I can see many people. They are students. They are studying in a classroom. I can also see desks and books.
hints.better: In this picture, I can see many students and a teacher in a classroom. The students are sitting at their desks and studying. I can also see books, desks and a board.
hints.strong: In this picture, I can see a classroom with many students and a teacher. The students are sitting at their desks, listening and taking notes. There are books on the desks and a board at the front. It looks like a normal lesson at school.

tests.title: Free time
tests.vocab: friends, park, grass, sitting, talking, smiling, tree, sunny, relax, free time

questions.q: What do you like doing in your free time?

hints.better: In my free time I like listening to music and playing games.
hints.strong: In my free time I like listening to music, playing football with friends, and watching short videos online.

questions.q: Do you often go out with friends?

hints.better: Yes, I often go out with my friends at the weekend.
hints.strong: Yes, I often go out with my friends at the weekend. We usually go to a café or walk in the park.

questions.q: What do you do on Sundays?

hints.better: On Sundays I stay at home and watch TV.
hints.strong: On Sundays I usually stay at home in the morning, then I meet my friends or help my parents in the afternoon.

questions.q: Do you like music?

hints.better: Yes, I like pop music very much.
hints.strong: Yes, I like music a lot, especially pop and soft songs. I often listen when I study or travel.

questions.q: What is your favourite place to relax?

hints.basic: My favourite place is my room.
hints.better: My favourite place to relax is the park near my house.
hints.strong: My favourite place to relax is the park near my house. It is quiet, green, and I can sit under a tree with my friends.

picture.vocabTip: Describe the people, the place, their feelings, and the weather if you can.

hints.basic: In this picture, I can see three people. They are friends. They are sitting in the park. I can also see grass and trees.
hints.better: In this picture, I can see three friends sitting on the grass in the park. They are talking and smiling. I can also see trees and a green area. They look relaxed.
hints.strong: In this picture, I can see three friends sitting together on the grass in a sunny park. They are chatting and smiling, so they look very relaxed and happy. Around them there are trees and a green open space — a nice place to spend free time.

tests.title: Shopping
tests.vocab: supermarket, shoppers, trolley, food, shelves, buying, choosing, store, weekly, near

questions.q: How often do you go shopping?

hints.basic: I go shopping once a week.
hints.better: I usually go shopping once or twice a week.
hints.strong: I usually go shopping once or twice a week, mostly at the weekend with my family.

questions.q: What do you usually buy at the supermarket?

hints.better: I usually buy rice, vegetables, milk and fruit.
hints.strong: I usually buy rice, vegetables, milk and fruit for the week. Sometimes I also buy snacks or drinks.

questions.q: Do you like shopping with family or friends?

hints.basic: I like shopping with my family.
hints.better: I like shopping with my family because it is fun.
hints.strong: I like shopping with my family because we can choose food together. With friends it is more fun, but we buy fewer useful things.

questions.q: What food do you buy every week?

hints.better: Every week I buy rice, eggs and vegetables.
hints.strong: Every week I buy rice, eggs, vegetables and milk because we need them for daily meals.

questions.q: Is there a supermarket near your home?

hints.better: Yes, there is a supermarket near my home.
hints.strong: Yes, there is a supermarket about five minutes from my home, so it is very convenient.

picture.vocabTip: Mention shoppers, trolleys, shelves and what people are choosing.

hints.basic: In this picture, I can see some people. They are in a supermarket. They are buying things. I can also see shelves.
hints.better: In this picture, I can see some shoppers in a supermarket. They are walking and buying food. I can also see shelves, food and shopping trolleys.
hints.strong: In this picture, I can see several shoppers in a supermarket. They are walking between the shelves and choosing food. There are shopping trolleys and many products on the shelves. It looks busy and normal for a shopping day.

tests.title: Food and drink
tests.vocab: restaurant, customers, table, meal, eating, talking, plates, drinks, favourite, spicy

questions.q: What is your favourite food?

hints.better: My favourite food is phở because it is delicious.
hints.strong: My favourite food is phở. I love the hot soup and fresh herbs, especially on a cool morning.

questions.q: What do you usually drink at lunch?

hints.better: At lunch I usually drink water or iced tea.
hints.strong: At lunch I usually drink water or iced tea. I try not to drink too many soft drinks.

questions.q: How often do you eat out?

hints.basic: I eat out once a week.
hints.better: I eat out about once or twice a week.
hints.strong: I eat out about once or twice a week, usually with my family at the weekend.

questions.q: Can you cook? What can you cook?

hints.better: Yes, I can cook simple food like fried eggs and noodles.
hints.strong: Yes, I can cook simple dishes like fried eggs, noodles and rice. I am learning to cook better from my mother.

questions.q: Do you like spicy food?

hints.better: Yes, I like spicy food a little, but not too hot.
hints.strong: Yes, I like spicy food a little, but not very hot. I usually add a small amount of chilli to my meals.

picture.vocabTip: Talk about the customers, the meal, and the atmosphere at the table.

hints.basic: In this picture, I can see some people. They are in a restaurant. They are eating. I can also see plates and glasses.
hints.better: In this picture, I can see several people in a restaurant. They are customers and friends. They are eating and talking together. I can also see plates, glasses and a table with food.
hints.strong: In this picture, I can see a group of friends or colleagues sitting around a table in a restaurant. They are sharing a meal, eating and chatting happily. There are plates, glasses and food on the table, and the mood looks friendly and relaxed.

tests.title: Sports and health
tests.vocab: people, exercise, sports clothes, park, running, stretching, healthy, outdoor, active, team

questions.q: Do you play any sports?

hints.better: Yes, I play football with my friends after school.
hints.strong: Yes, I play football two or three times a week with my friends. It helps me stay fit and have fun.

questions.q: How often do you exercise?

hints.better: I usually exercise two or three times a week.
hints.strong: I usually exercise two or three times a week — for example jogging in the park or playing football.

questions.q: What do you do to stay healthy?

hints.basic: I eat vegetables and sleep early.
hints.better: To stay healthy I eat vegetables, drink water and sleep early.
hints.strong: To stay healthy I try to eat more vegetables, drink enough water, sleep early, and do some exercise every week.

questions.q: Do you prefer indoor or outdoor activities?

hints.better: I prefer outdoor activities because I like fresh air.
hints.strong: I prefer outdoor activities because I like fresh air and sunshine. Indoor sports are fine when it rains.

questions.q: Who do you like doing sports with?

hints.basic: I like doing sports with my friends.
hints.better: I like doing sports with my classmates after school.
hints.strong: I like doing sports with my classmates after school. Playing in a team is more fun than exercising alone.

picture.vocabTip: Describe the activity, clothes, place, and how the people look (active, healthy).

hints.basic: In this picture, I can see some people. They are doing exercise. They are outdoors. I can also see sports clothes.
hints.better: In this picture, I can see a group of people doing exercise outdoors. Some are stretching and some are moving together. I can also see sports clothes and an open space. They look active.
hints.strong: In this picture, I can see a group of people exercising outdoors in an open space, maybe a park. They are wearing sports clothes; some are stretching while others are moving together. They look active and healthy, and the activity seems good for fitness.

tests.title: Travel and transport
tests.topic: People waiting at a bus stop
tests.vocab: bus stop, passengers, bus, waiting, bag, road, street, travelling, city, transport

questions.q: How do you usually travel to school or work?

hints.better: I usually go to school by bike.
hints.strong: I usually go to school by bike because it is cheap and good exercise. When I am late, I take a bus.

questions.q: Do you often take the bus?

hints.better: Yes, I sometimes take the bus to the city centre.
hints.strong: Yes, I sometimes take the bus to the city centre, especially when the weather is bad or I need to travel far.

questions.q: What transport do you like best?

hints.better: I like the bike best because it is free and healthy.
hints.strong: I like the bike best because it is free, healthy and flexible. For long trips I prefer the train.

questions.q: Do you want to visit another city?

hints.better: Yes, I want to visit Da Nang.
hints.strong: Yes, I want to visit Da Nang because I have never been there. I would like to see the beach and try local food.

questions.q: Who do you usually travel with?

hints.better: I usually travel with my family or my friends.
hints.strong: I usually travel with my family on holidays, and with my friends for short trips at the weekend.

picture.vocabTip: Say who is waiting, what they are carrying, and what you can see on the road.

hints.basic: In this picture, I can see some people. They are at a bus stop. They are waiting for the bus. I can also see the road.
hints.better: In this picture, I can see some passengers at a bus stop. They are waiting for the bus. I can also see the road, a bus and some bags. It looks like a normal day.
hints.strong: In this picture, I can see several passengers waiting at a bus stop by the road. Some are holding bags and looking towards the street. There is a bus nearby, so it seems like a normal weekday morning when people travel to school or work.

tests.title: Holidays
tests.vocab: family, beach, sea, sand, children, playing, holiday, sunny, mountains, travel

questions.q: Where do you like going on holiday?

hints.basic: I like going to the beach.
hints.better: I like going to the beach with my family.
hints.strong: I like going to the beach on holiday because I can swim, walk on the sand and eat seafood.

questions.q: Do you like the beach or the mountains?

hints.better: I like the beach more than the mountains.
hints.strong: I like the beach more than the mountains because I enjoy swimming and the sea air. The mountains are nice too, but cooler.

questions.q: What do you usually do on holiday?

hints.better: On holiday I usually swim, eat local food and take photos.
hints.strong: On holiday I usually swim, try local food, take photos and spend time with my family without thinking about homework.

questions.q: Who do you like travelling with?

hints.basic: I like travelling with my family.
hints.better: I like travelling with my family because it is safe and fun.
hints.strong: I like travelling with my family because we can share meals and visit new places together. Sometimes I also travel with close friends.

questions.q: What do you take to the beach?

hints.basic: I take a towel and water.
hints.better: I take a towel, water, sunscreen and a hat.
hints.strong: I usually take a towel, water, sunscreen, a hat and my phone to take photos. Sometimes I also take snacks.

picture.vocabTip: Describe the family, the sea and sand, and what the children are doing.

hints.basic: In this picture, I can see a family. They are at the beach. They are playing. I can also see the sea and sand.
hints.better: In this picture, I can see a family with adults and children. They are spending time at the beach and playing together. I can also see the sea, the sand and sunshine.
hints.strong: In this picture, I can see a family enjoying a holiday at the beach. The adults and children are playing together on the sand near the sea. The weather looks sunny, and everyone seems relaxed and happy — a typical summer holiday scene.

tests.title: Special days
tests.vocab: birthday, friends, cake, candles, party, smiling, celebration, balloons, present, invite

questions.q: When is your birthday?

hints.better: My birthday is on the 12th of May.
hints.strong: My birthday is on the 12th of May. I usually celebrate it with my family and a few close friends.

questions.q: How do you celebrate your birthday?

hints.better: I have a small party at home with cake and friends.
hints.strong: I usually have a small party at home. We eat cake, take photos and sometimes sing karaoke together.

questions.q: Do you like parties?

hints.better: Yes, I like small parties with my friends.
hints.strong: Yes, I like small parties with close friends more than big noisy ones. I enjoy chatting and sharing food.

questions.q: What present do you want on your birthday?

hints.better: I want a new book or a pair of headphones.
hints.strong: I would love a new book or a pair of headphones. I don’t need expensive gifts — something useful is enough.

questions.q: Who do you invite to your birthday party?

hints.basic: I invite my family and friends.
hints.better: I invite my family and a few close friends.
hints.strong: I invite my family and a few close friends from school. I prefer a small group so we can talk more.

picture.vocabTip: Mention the cake, candles, decorations and how people feel.

hints.basic: In this picture, I can see some people. They are at a birthday party. They are looking at a cake. I can also see candles.
hints.better: In this picture, I can see several friends at a birthday party. They are celebrating and looking at a birthday cake. I can also see candles and party decorations. They look excited.
hints.strong: In this picture, I can see a group of friends celebrating a birthday. They are gathered around a cake with candles, smiling and looking excited. There are party decorations, maybe balloons, and the mood feels joyful and warm.

tests.title: Jobs
tests.vocab: office, workers, meeting, laptop, table, discussing, team, business, skill, future

questions.q: What job would you like in the future?

hints.basic: I would like to be a teacher.
hints.better: In the future I would like to be an English teacher.
hints.strong: In the future I would like to be an English teacher or work in an international company, because I enjoy languages and meeting people.

questions.q: What does your father or mother do?

hints.better: My mother is a teacher and my father works in an office.
hints.strong: My mother is a primary school teacher, and my father works in an office. They both work hard every day.

questions.q: Do you want to work in an office?

hints.better: Yes, I want to work in an office if the job is interesting.
hints.strong: Yes, I would like to work in an office if the job is interesting and I can learn new skills. I also like jobs that are not always indoors.

questions.q: Do you like working alone or in a team?

hints.basic: I like working in a team.
hints.better: I like working in a team because we can help each other.
hints.strong: I like working in a team because we can share ideas and help each other. Sometimes I also need quiet time to work alone.

questions.q: What is an important skill for a job?

hints.better: English and teamwork are important skills for a job.
hints.strong: I think English, teamwork and problem-solving are important skills for many jobs today, especially in an office.

picture.vocabTip: Describe the meeting, the laptop/table, and whether people look busy or focused.

hints.basic: In this picture, I can see five people. They are in an office. They are talking. I can also see a laptop and a table.
hints.better: In this picture, I can see five office workers. They are having a meeting and talking together. I can also see a laptop, a table and bright windows. They look busy.
hints.strong: In this picture, I can see five office workers sitting around a table in a bright office. They are having a meeting, discussing something and looking at a laptop. The atmosphere looks professional and busy — a typical workday scene.
